recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-13217 in the current FHIR source unless a future work-group decision changes the sliceName character policy more broadly.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 change request to correct ElementDefinition invariant eld-16 because profiling guidance for reslicing uses forward slashes in names such as originalSlice/newSlice, but the old sliceName regex excluded forward slashes.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-13217-tagged source commit was found. The issue appears to have been applied by git-svn commit a21e185d53af30a5b5f984dd72dc44cfe4074d32, whose subject says "bug fixes - eld-16 wrong" and whose patch changed eld-16 from a single-token regex to slash-separated token wording and slash-allowing FHIRPath/XPath regexes.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps ElementDefinition in the active datatype inputs and maps it to the elementdefinition page. source/profiling.html still explains reslicing with / separators, including example/example1 and @default/@default. Later same-family eld-16 issues adjusted bracket, @default, and regex-escaping details without reversing slash support.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope ElementDefinition spreadsheet already says sliceName is composed of proper tokens separated by "/" and allows / in the eld-16 FHIRPath and XPath regexes.
